data.description: Jebel Ali, the bustling port cityscape, blends seamlessly with the serene beauty of the Arabian Gulf.

data.answer:
With over 7,000 companies operating in JAFZA across various sectors like trade, logistics, manufacturing, and services, the economic impact of this region is substantial. Notably, the area's significance is increasing, with tourism playing a pivotal role, thanks to its stunning resorts.

Despite Jebel Ali’s industrial prominence, various residential options are available here. For those contemplating a move to this steadily developing district in Dubai, an array of villas in Jebel Ali awaits your selection.

The community is experiencing ongoing expansion, marked by numerous new developments in the region. Although the community mainly consists of villas and townhouses, diverse apartment options are available for rent and purchase, allowing you to tailor your choice according to your preferences.

Most Popular Communities in Jebel Ali Dubai

The residential pockets within and around the area include Jebel Ali Village and Discovery Gardens and The Gardens. Notably, the Veneto community, developed by Nakheel within the development, presents an extensive array of luxurious townhouses and villas.

Another development is Downtown Jebel Ali, hosting a remarkable assortment of hotels, apartments, offices, and retail spaces, contributing to the area's evolving landscape. Distinguished as a prominent industrial center, the predominant property types in this area are warehouses and labor camps. It ranks among Dubai's top areas for warehouse rentals, with a starting rental price of AED 880,000 per annum.

Jebel Ali Hills is a premier residential community located in Jebel Ali. It consists of apartments, villas, and plots of land, while Garden View Villas is a complex featuring 3-bed villas. Moreover, the Al Muntazah Complex is a popular residential development with various amenities.

Badrah by Nakheel is another meticulously planned community in Jebel Ali featuring 645 townhouses and eight apartment buildings. The development provides residents a superior quality of life, incorporating tree-lined boulevards, parks, and dedicated children’s play areas.  Jebel Ali Hills is a residential land development in the area with freehold plots for sale.

Off-Plan Projects in Jebel Ali Dubai

Experience the ultimate luxury at Palm Jebel Ali by Nakheel, a Jebel Ali district luxury district. It offers a stunning array of Beach Villas and Coral Villas. The villas for sale in Jebel Ali community have been meticulously designed with attention to detail, offering a perfect combination of contemporary design and unparalleled comfort, seamlessly blending the beauty of the sea, sky, and a breathtaking beachfront with your living space. It also features seven magnificent ensuite bedrooms, formal living areas, a guard's house and a double maid's room.

Equiti Gate in Downtown Jebel Ali is an impressive off-plan tower by B.N.H Developer, featuring studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Its remarkable design encompasses a ground floor, three podiums, and 14 floors, providing fully furnished homes and guaranteeing a secure investment in one of Dubai's most esteemed locations. The project is expected to be completed in Q4 2024.

Renting a Property in Jebel Ali 

There are many apartments for rent in Jebel Ali. For a typical studio for rent in Jebel Ali with a minimum of 391 sq. ft. covered space, you might have to pay AED 45,000. Similarly, 1-bedroom apartments are available for an annual rent of around AED 40,888, while 2-bedroom flats in Jebel Ali are available for a starting rental price of AED 56,000 annually.

Villas for rent in Jebel Ali come in 4, 5 and 6-bedroom configurations, with notable options in projects like Al Muntazah Complex and Garden View Villas. The minimum annual rent for 5-bedroom villas is AED 185,000 annually.

Buying a Property in Jebel Ali 

Regarding properties available for purchase in Jebel Ali, the offerings primarily consist of residential plots and commercial properties. Nevertheless, few apartments for sale in Jebel Ali range from studios to 2-bedroom units. Studio prices start from AED 470,000, 1-bedroom flats have an average price of AED 440,000, and a 2-bedroom apartment is available for AED 800,000.

For those seeking investment opportunities, residential plots for sale in Jebel Ali are available from AED 850,000 to AED 4.1 million.

In the realm of commercial properties for sale, Jebel Ali's advantageous proximity to warehouses and major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), positions it as a preferred business location. This makes it one of the prime areas for purchasing commercial properties in Dubai, encompassing offices, warehouses, and labor camps. The starting price for a 3,000 sq. ft. office is approximately AED 1.68 million, while the price for warehouses in Jebel Ali might begin at AED 2 million.

Commercial Properties for Rent in Jebel Ali Dubai

The industrial and commercial segment of the community provides a diverse array of rental options, including offices, retail spaces, shops, and labor camps. Office rentals in Jebel Ali, Dubai, range from AED 39k to AED 75k, with the covered area spanning 850 sq. ft. to 2,500 sq. ft. Shops in Jebel Ali for rent are available for a price between AED 100k and AED 212k.

Sale Trends in Jebel Ali

For properties on sale in Jebel Ali, residential plots and commercial units dominate the market, along with a limited number of apartments. When it comes to apartments for sale, the price of studios starts from AED 470,000, whereas 1-bed flats average at AED 440,000. 2-bedroom apartments may cost over AED 800k. Plots in Jebel Ali range from AED 1.74M to AED 4.1M.

You can also find various villas for sale in Jebel Ali. A 3-BHK villa in the Jebel Ali Village community will cost at least AED 3.25M, whereas the price for a 4-bedroom house is about AED 3.65M. The minimum sales price for 5-bedroom and 6-bedroom villas in the area is AED 4.99M and AED 6M, respectively.

Commercial properties for sale are available for a starting price of AED 1.68M, while warehouses may cost around AED 2M. The expected minimum price for labor camps for sale is AED 3.5M, covering an area of 10,000 sq. ft.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Jebel Ali?

data.answer:
Life in Jebel Ali offers a unique blend of industrial vibrancy, economic opportunities, and recreational amenities. As a crucial commercial and business hub, the community is characterized by a dynamic and cosmopolitan atmosphere.

Public Transportation in Jebel Ali 

Jebel Ali is known for its excellent public transportation connections in Dubai. Firstly, it houses the Jebel Ali Metro Station, situated on the red line of the Dubai Metro. This station serves as the initial stop for the Route 2020 Extension, stretching to Al Furjan Station. Several other stations are conveniently located along Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), including Ibn Battuta Metro Station, The Gardens Metro Station, Energy Metro Station, and UAE Exchange Metro Station.

Regarding public transportation, various bus routes connect Jebel Ali to different city areas, such as Al Karama, Lulu Village, Gold Souq Bus Station, Al Ghubaiba Bus Station, and more. Hailing taxi cabs is also a hassle-free option for commuters in the area.

Supermarkets in Jebel Ali

In Jebel Ali, you have several supermarkets to fulfill your grocery needs. To begin with, Carrefour is a favored choice for your monthly grocery shopping. Additionally, near the free zone, you can conveniently locate Meena Centre FZE, Nesto Hypermarket, and Village Hypermarket.

The Sultan Hypermarket is on the opposite side. Furthermore, the Jebel Ali Industrial Area hosts various supermarkets, including New Parco Supermarket, Malabar Supermarket, Salam Al Madeena Supermarket, Zabeel Oasis Supermarket, and others to cater to your preferences.

Shopping Malls in Jebel Ali 

Your primary shopping needs can be met at Ibn Battuta Mall in the Nakheel Jebel Ali Village. Apart from various retail options, the mall features entertainment venues like Fun City, Sky Zone, and Novo Cinema.

Another shopping destination accessible to Jebel Ali residents is the Dubai Festival Plaza. It houses numerous high-street fashion brands, retail outlets, dining places and LuLu Hypermarket. There is also a small retail center named Jebel Ali Mall close to the area's industrial side.

Schools in Jebel Ali Dubai

Regarding educational facilities, residents have many options in Jebel Ali, ensuring diverse choices. Several nurseries and primary schools are available, including Little Woods, Bubbles and Giggles Nursery, and Jebel Ali Village Nursery. Hamilton Primary School stands out as a notable option in this category.

In the realm of specialized education, Harmony Ballet & Music Centre offers ballet classes. Additionally, there are various other educational choices within and outside the community. Jebel Ali School provides a curriculum based on the UK educational system, and for those seeking another reputable UK curriculum option, The Winchester School is also located in the area. Delhi Private School is a popular choice for students following the Indian curriculum, while the Greenfield Community School adopts the IB system and is situated in the neighboring community.

For photography enthusiasts, the Nikon School Dubai offers a series of courses to enhance photographers' technical and creative skills. Older students can attend one of the universities in the Knowledge Village, which is approximately 20 minutes from the Jebel Ali area.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Jebel Ali

Several mosques are situated across various areas within the district. Noteworthy mosques in the Jebel Ali Industrial Area include Masjid Ruqaya, Masjid Handalath bin Abi Umar, and others. The striking Jebel Ali Beach Masjid and New East Accommodation Mosque are also a convenient drive away from the residential communities in Jebel Ali.

Guru Nanak Darbar, the first ISO-certified Sikh Gurudwara in Nakheel Jebel Ali Village, is available nearby. Additionally, there are numerous churches near the temple. St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, often called Jebel Ali Church, holds a special place. Other options include the United Christian Church of Dubai, Dubai Mar Thoma Church, and St. Mina Coptic Orthodox Church. These religious centers are reachable within 17 to 20 minutes from the residential side of the development.

Clinics and Hospitals in Jebel Ali 

Regarding healthcare amenities, numerous clinics and hospitals are conveniently located nearby. Notable options include the Cedars Jebel Ali International Hospital, LiveCare Clinic, Aster Clinic branch, and nearby similar healthcare facilities.

Location & Nearby Areas

Jebel Ali is strategically located in Dubai, surrounded by various key areas. Situated adjacent to the Jebel Ali location, Dubai Investments Park (DIP) is a mixed-use development with industrial, commercial, and residential zones.

Al Maktoum International Airport is near Jebel Ali, providing convenient access for residents and businesses. Located northeast of Jebel Ali, Dubai Marina is a waterfront community known for its skyscrapers, restaurants, and recreational options. Approximately 20 minutes away, Knowledge Village is a hub for education and training institutions.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Jebel Ali

data.answer:
Jebel Ali location offers diverse activities and attractions for residents and visitors. Dubai Parks & Resorts is a must-visit destination for those seeking entertainment, housing thrilling theme parks like Motiongate Dubai and Legoland Dubai. The stunning Jebel Ali Beach provides a serene escape for relaxation and water activities. Golf enthusiasts can enjoy a round at the renowned golf resort in the area. For shopping, Jebel Ali Mall and Dubai Festival Plaza offer a variety of retail options. You can also enjoy the latest flick at Reel Cinemas Jebel Ali Village.

Additionally, the industrial side showcases the bustling Jebel Ali Free Zone, providing a unique glimpse into the region's economic activity. The community's strategic location allows easy access to Dubai Marina, Knowledge Village, and Al Maktoum International Airport. Whether indulging in theme park adventures, beachside relaxation, or exploring the vibrant economic hub, Jebel Ali caters to diverse interests and preferences.

Jebel Ali Restaurants and Bars

When it comes to dining, Jebel Ali boasts a plethora of restaurants catering to various tastes, along with numerous cafes and an array of fast-food establishments. The options are diverse and abundant, including Qasr Al Jabal Restaurant, Village Restaurant, and Field to Fork Jafza.

The neighborhood features cafes such as Costa Coffee, Starbucks, and Caribou Coffee, while fast food lovers can head to McDonald's, Hardee's, and KFC. The culinary scene in Jebel Ali offers a rich and varied experience, ensuring there's something for every palate and preference.

Beaches Near Jebel Ali 

Jebel Ali is conveniently located near some of Dubai's pristine beaches, offering residents and visitors ample opportunities for coastal relaxation and water activities. One notable option is Jebel Ali Beach, known for its scenic beauty and serene atmosphere. This sandy stretch is ideal for those looking to unwind, sunbathe, or engage in water sports. The nearby Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) also boasts a vibrant seaside ambiance, with various restaurants, shops, and entertainment options.

The renowned Kite Beach, located a short drive away, is popular among water sports enthusiasts and those seeking a lively beach atmosphere. Whether it's enjoying the tranquility of Jebel Ali Beach or exploring the vibrant scenes at JBR and Kite Beach, the coastal offerings near Jebel Ali cater to a diverse range of beachgoers.

Hotels in Jebel Ali 

This Dubai industrial district and business hub also hosts several prestigious high-end hotels. Among the top hotels in Jebel Ali is JA Palm Tree Court. It is recognized as an award-winning 5-star hotel along the sparkling Gulf shores. Boasting 208 spacious suites just steps away from the sea, the hotel offers many entertainment options, including water sports, a golf club, pools, a spa, a fitness center, and swim-up bars. Adventure enthusiasts can explore the Jebel Ali Shooting Club, which is designed with international safety standards to cater to beginners and seasoned shooters.

The Manor By JA is conveniently positioned near the Expo 2020 site. The Manor By JA is an excellent choice for visitors and corporate guests seeking proximity to Al Maktoum Airport and the JAFZA business district. The hotel features all-day dining facilities, comfortably sized beds, a spa, and a pool, making it an attractive option for diverse guests. ECOS Dubai Hotel at Al Furjan is also a nearby option for Jebel Ali residents.

Attractions and Landmarks near Jebel Ali

A prominent industrial zone, a free zone, and an expansive residential development, Jebel Ali is conveniently located near Dubai Marina and Dubai Investments Park. A major attraction in the area is Ibn Battuta Gate and Ibn Battuta Mall, near Jebel Ali Village. It takes approximately 20 minutes from Ibn Battuta Gate to reach the heart of Mina Jebel Ali. The community boasts exclusive leisure spots, and residents have easy access to popular entertainment venues nearby.

Jebel Ali Beach Hotel is a 5-star beachfront resort offering breathtaking views of the Gulf shores. This award-winning property features a private marina and lush hotel gardens, providing a luxurious family getaway. Alongside its palm-lined beach, the resort offers two swimming pools, a decadent spa, various bars and restaurants, children’s entertainment clubs, and sports facilities.

The fantastic Jebel Ali Golf Resort features a standard 9-hole par 36 course with exciting challenges and beautiful scenery. Besides golfing, participants can enjoy dining facilities at Vasco Da Gama, Phoenicia, and other restaurants within the resort.

Another notable landmark is the Palm Jebel Ali, the second of the wondrous man-made islands by Nakheel, currently on hold in its construction. Bollywood Parks Dubai is right opposite Palm Jebel Ali for a fun evening with the family.

Jebel Ali Sports Club, also known as JA Sports Club, is a popular venue in the area.  It features a championship golf course, equestrian center and tennis courts. There is much to do at the club, from trying out a new watersport to a spa treatment.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

There are limited options when it comes to parks in Jebel Ali. However, residents can visit the Dubai Parks and Resorts on Sheikh Zayed Road for outdoor activities. The attraction features various leisure destinations, including Motiongate and Legoland Dubai.

For fitness facilities, residents can visit Ibn Battuta Mall. The retail destination houses various gyms, such as Fitness First and Warehouse Gym, while Azurro by Niyama Spa and Dear Barber (Gents Salon) are the best beauty facilities in the mall.

Jebel Ali is at a considerable distance from the city center of Dubai. The commute might be longer if you frequently need to access the central areas. Public transportation options might be limited, potentially leading to a reliance on private vehicles for commuting.

Where is Jebel Ali located?

Jebel Ali is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and is known as a major industrial and business hub.

Why is Jebel Ali famous?

Jebel Ali is renowned as a major economic and industrial center, housing the prominent Port Jebel Ali, one of the largest deep-water ports globally.

Is Jebel Ali Abu Dhabi or Dubai?

Jebel Ali is located in Dubai, not Abu Dhabi. It is a port town on the southern outskirts of Dubai along the southwestern part of the Persian Gulf.

What is the difference between Jabal Ali and Jebel Ali?

"Jabal Ali" and "Jebel Ali" refer to the same location, with the primary difference being the transliteration of the Arabic name into English.

Is Jebel Ali a good place to live?

Jebel Ali is a thriving industrial and business hub in Dubai, offering modern infrastructure, job opportunities, and residential communities. The area also features schools, shopping centers, and recreational facilities.

What are the key features of Jebel Ali?

Jebel Ali is recognized for its industrial significance, hosting the Jebel Ali Free Zone, commercial port, and business establishments. It is also home to residential communities, hotels, and entertainment facilities.

What are the prominent landmarks in Jebel Ali?

Notable landmarks include the Ibn Battuta Gate, Ibn Battuta Mall, and the Jebel Ali Beach Hotel. The Jebel Ali Golf Resort and the Jebel Ali Recreational Club are popular destinations.

Are there beaches in Jebel Ali?

Jebel Ali has a beachfront, and the Jebel Ali Beach Hotel is a well-known 5-star beachfront resort.

What leisure and entertainment options are available in Jebel Ali?

Residents and visitors can enjoy theme parks at Dubai Parks & Resorts, including Motiongate Dubai and Legoland Dubai. The area also has golf resorts, recreational clubs, and proximity to Bollywood Parks Dubai.

Is Jebel Ali Village Nursery The Lakes open?

No, the nursery is permanently closed.

What are the nearby fitness options for Jebel Ali residents?

The closest gyms are in Ibn Battuta Mall, which includes Fitness First and Warehouse Gym. Champs Sports Club in Festival Plaza is also a nearby option for Jebel Ali residents.

Is there public transportation in Jebel Ali?

Yes, Jebel Ali is well-connected with public transportation, including the Dubai Metro (Red Line) and a network of buses.

data.content:
Jebel Ali is a thriving community in the heart of Dubai, renowned for its strategic location and rich history. It is a mixed-use area comprising commercial, industrial, and residential sub-districts.

Jebel Ali Port (the world's largest man-made harbor), Palm Jebel Ali, JAFZA (a designated industrial area), and Jebel Ali Village are all part of the expansive Jebel Ali District. A noteworthy aspect of its popularity is evident in the Palm Jebel Ali project, one of Dubai's three luxury artificial islands crafted as a palm tree. Furthermore, the area boasts a golf resort, beach hotel, and multiple diving centers.

Jebel Ali is situated along the southwestern part of the Persian Gulf and is known for its deep-water port, one of the region's largest and busiest. Jebel Ali plays a crucial role in the industrial landscape of Dubai, acting as a significant commercial port and business hub.

nodes.title: Azizi Lina
nodes.about:
Azizi Lina at Downtown Jebel Ali Dubai is a freehold project developed by Azizi Developments, featuring a selection of studios to 3-bedroom apartments. The project is crafted with elegant interiors, premium facilities, and thoughtful spaces, making it ideal for both investors and end-users.

Situated beside the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA) and close to over 100 Fortune Global 500 companies, the project combines residential living with unmatched business accessibility. Azizi Lina at Jebel Ali ensures seamless connectivity with Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai Metro, and leading lifestyle and leisure hubs, setting a new standard for urban living.

nodes.title: Azizi Wares
nodes.about:
Azizi Wares, developed by Azizi Developments, brings a new standard of contemporary living to Downtown Jebel Ali, one of Dubai’s fastest-growing business and residential hubs. The project features a selection of studios and spacious 1 to 3-bedroom apartments designed for modern lifestyles.

Each home is semi-furnished, boasting functional layouts, stylish interiors, and panoramic windows that maximize natural light. Positioned beside JAFZA and just minutes from the Metro, Azizi Wares Dubai offers unmatched connectivity to the city’s most iconic landmarks.

nodes.title: Gate Royale Residences
nodes.about:
Gate Royale Residences is an exclusive residential development by Baron Development, set within the tranquil yet connected enclave of Jebel Ali Village, Dubai. Rising 11 floors above ground and offering just 60 premium residences, this low-density project delivers a boutique living experience. Designed to meet the needs of modern families and professionals, the project features a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3-bedroom duplexes.

With attractive prices and just a 10% down payment, Gate Royale Residences presents an accessible opportunity in one of Dubai’s established communities. The project combines refined architectural design, efficient floor plans, and a prime location near key transport routes—offering both lifestyle appeal and long-term investment value. Whether for end-use or leasing potential, the residences cater to a sophisticated buyer seeking quality, comfort, and future growth.

nodes.title: Azizi Plaza
nodes.about:
Plaza is a modern 15-storey building in Dubai, in the Meydan One quarter, on Nad Al Sheba Street 1, which combines the best of French Mediterranean design and modern architecture, creating the perfect place for modern community living.

Plaza offers studios and apartments with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms for purchase. Each apartment has panoramic windows and seamless balconies.

Children's and adult pools, recreation areas with barbecue facilities, sports and playgrounds, yoga studios, a gym, a zen meditation garden, a lounge with a night cinema, a pet walking area are available for all residents of the complex. Commercial premises are open on the ground floor of the building: shops, restaurants, coffee shops. The tower has parking and 24-hour security.

The convenient location of the facility ensures the convenience of traveling by private transport, while public transport is also available. A 17—minute drive from AZIZI Riviera there is a comprehensive school and a kindergarten - Canadian Kids Nursery, 30 minutes away there is a Russian International School. Carrefour Hypermarket or Fruit Market can be reached in 15-20 minutes by car. Meydan One Mall is a 15-minute walk away.

nodes.title: Azizi Zain
nodes.about:
Azizi Zain is a multi-storey residential complex from the developer Azizi Developers located in the picturesque area of Jebel Ali Village. Apartments with 1, 2 and 3 bedrooms are available for sale. The apartments offer magnificent views of the pool and the picturesque garden.

The complex offers world-class amenities for residents: an infinity pool and a children's pool, as well as a spacious recreation area.

Azizi Zain has an advantageous location: the complex is located next to Al Samuel Street, from where it is easy to reach the main transport interchanges. Discovery Garden Metro Station is just a 7-minute walk away, which provides uninterrupted connection to other areas. Sheikh Zayed Road is nearby, Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai Mall are a 30-minute drive away, and Dubai Airport is a 50-minute drive away.
